item.title: apv: A plugin manifest validator for agent plugins
item.description: In an earlier article, I introduced the Agent Plugin specification for packaging agent resources such as skills and MCP configurations. This packaging specification requires a plugin manifest (plugin.json) that agents and clients use to load the necessary agent resources. This manifest, as seen in the earlier article, has a strict schema. As I started exploring agent plugins for packaging skills and MCP configurations, I felt the need to quickly check whether the plugin manifest conforms to the schema. So, I built one!
